events.title: Oasis's Debut Album Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which quickly became the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Debut Album Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your top track from this iconic debut?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine being at Woodstock in '69. Which legendary performance would you have loved to witness live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: August 16th marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley today. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: September 13th marks 30 years since the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas; he would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Thirty years on, Tupac Shakur's lyrics and influence still resonate profoundly. Remembering a true icon of hip-hop today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: September 18th marks the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix in 1970; he would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix today. His innovative guitar work continues to shape music. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. The music and that cover remain timeless. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate the 75th birthday of Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, born in 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon whose voice and attitude continue to inspire. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Celebrating the 54th birthday of the one and only Liam Gallagher today, born in 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the inimitable Liam Gallagher! Love him or loathe him, his voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Liam moment or track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful and timeless album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, featuring his signature song.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine', a song that continues to resonate with its message of peace. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: October 23rd marks 25 years since Apple introduced the original iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched a device that changed music forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is officially James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the film series.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your absolute favourite thing about 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On October 9th, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace live on. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrating the 87th birthday of the legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese today, born in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped, showcasing their incredible diversity. Which track from the double LP is your hidden gem?
